test_Vector2_arithmetic: test Vector2 operator overloading including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with scalars and vectors
test_C1_C2_notimplemented: test C1 and C2 cross-type arithmetic operators that return NotImplemented for correct fallback behavior
test_NestA_NestB_NestC_nested: test nested class operator overloading on NestA, NestB, and NestC with in-place arithmetic
test_Comparable_hashable_eq: test Comparable and Hashable classes for equality comparison and hash behavior with overridden __eq__
test_unhashable_set_error: test that returning a set of unhashable objects raises a TypeError as expected
